Paths compare project-relative as zone_matches does, one real path stored once.

close_turn compares the git-steering snapshot before any post-turn git command; on a change it records the finding and marks the git probes skipped without running them. Each change is one steering_file finding with path, class (harness, git_hook, git_config, policy_tree, policy_blob, registry, review_file, shell_startup, env_bin, symlink), before and after (sha256, link:<target>, absent, or for git_config the changed values of core.hooksPath, core.fsmonitor, core.sshCommand, include.path, includeIf.*.path), replacing any porcelain or committed_outside_zones finding for that path. A sticky worker flag steering_changed shows in worker status --json flags and handoff status --json workers[].flags; a clean turn leaves it set; worker reconcile <id> without --dismiss prints one path class before after line per steering_file finding recorded while it was set, then clears it.
